meta.title: ESP32-C3 Rust board · rails fine, chip asleep
meta.author: DEADBOARD
meta.description: A real, sold ESP32-C3 training board (55 parts: sensors, RGB LED, Li-ion charger, USB-C). It came back from a workshop where someone spilled a drink on the bench, and another participant says it "only really worked on the battery" before that. On USB it now stays silent. No battery is plugged in on your bench. Bench supply: 5 V on Net-(D6-Pad2) (USB VBUS (5 V); at the connector, before D6).
hints: Every rail can look present while the chip does nothing: compare the supply current with what a running ESP32-C3 draws (tens of mA). Almost nothing means it is held in reset: measure CHIP_PU (U3 pin 8), pulled up to +3V3 by R8.
+5V should sit one Schottky drop below VBUS. Lower than that, and the board is running backwards from the charger through Q1's body diode: follow +5V back to the part that should feed it from VBUS.
Clean what is crusty (isopropyl takes a few scrubs) and reflow what is cracked.
